adapterScope.const: one adapter per prototype; admit/project dispatched per effect instance and per path; prototype status is a default only; unknown prototype rejected

directFacts.const: DirectFactRowV1[] evaluable fact rows: schemaVersion, factType, key, sourceActionId, sourceActorId, sourceEffectId, targetIds, amount, unit, durationTurns; declared magnitudes only, no mitigation/hit final settlement; column-code strings are not contributions

legalityModifiers.const: target-legality modifiers derived from current public state only (taunt source constraint, control cancellation, disarm or silence rules, state migration and erasure of taunt or control); forced taunt target set is sorted UTF-16 ascending; unique-target mechanisms with more than one taunter reject AMBIGUOUS_TAUNT_TARGET

opportunityModifiers.const: opportunity identity and distribution modifiers (judgment rates, interference rates, resource locks) that enter candidate dependency tokens; declared magnitudes; mechanicMetadata holds per-effect-instance projection metadata (sourceEffectId plus prototype-allowed Chinese field-name keys 生效方式/结算标签/抗性类型/驱动属性/影响方向/对应等级) as verbatim normalized deep clones that are deep-frozen and never used for scoring/weighting

scheduledFacts.const: S5 scheduled and window facts (delayed triggers, duration adjustments, follow-up or summon window grants); 机制授予 carries triggerKey, maxActions and payload DirectFactRowV1 rows; triggerKey enum 主动触发/随下次行动触发 only; maxActions comes only from explicit 可用次数 (主动触发), missing 可用次数 rejects MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD, 随下次行动触发 projects no maxActions; SUMMON_WINDOW carries durationTurns/strength; window adjust keys window.adjustTurns/window.settlementRatio

unsupportedOutcomeKinds.const: outcome kinds this adapter cannot project; non-empty only together with deferCode or an explicit reason code

deferCode.const: per-path defer code; empty string when the path is fully supported

candidateRetention.const: deferred candidates retain vector coverage and candidateAudit reason
